shortDesc: A post's whole discussion: comment box, then nested replies with thread lines, author and age, compact votes, Reply (opens an inline reply box) and Delete on the viewer's own comments; deleted comments keep their place so replies stay attached. Give it the post-id; it loads the comments itself.

styling.notes: 2px grey thread line per nesting level; italic grey for deleted comments.

dependencies.usage: Top-level comment box and inline reply boxes.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'get a post with its comments', postId, outputFormat: { post, comments: [{ id, body, author, createdAt, edited, score, deleted, myVote, mine, replies }] } }
{ intent: 'delete comment', postId, commentId, outputFormat: { ok: 'boolean' } }
